header: One to four rings, each drawn by a conic-gradient
lead: The angle is read from the digits in the value, so type 72% rather than roughly three quarters. The ring is a background image with a radial mask over it — no chart library, no SVG and nothing computed at render time.
note: The percentage stands in the middle of its own ring as text, so the drawing can be ignored entirely and the band still says the same thing.

metrics.title: A full ring
metrics.text: Clamped, so a value above a hundred stops at a closed circle.

metrics.title: A partial ring
metrics.text: The sweep starts at twelve o'clock and runs clockwise.

metrics.title: An empty ring
metrics.text: Nothing typed reads as nothing reached, never as complete.
